Name: LLM Inference Service Detection (Ollama)
Synopsis: Ollama 0.1.32 LLM inference server detected on tcp/11434. The /api/tags endpoint responded WITHOUT authentication. Loaded models: llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M, qwen2.5:14b-instruct, nomic-embed-text:latest. GPU: NVIDIA A100-40GB. This confirms an internally-hosted LLM in production use.

Name: Ollama Path Traversal Remote Code Execution (Probllama)
Synopsis: Ollama before 0.1.34 is affected by a path traversal in the model pull/push API (digest handling) allowing arbitrary file write and remote code execution on the inference host. The exposed unauthenticated API on tcp/11434 is directly exploitable.

Name: Ollama Out-of-Bounds Read Denial of Service via crafted GGUF
Synopsis: Ollama is vulnerable to a denial of service via a crafted GGUF model file that triggers an out-of-bounds read in the /api/create path, crashing the inference service.

Name: Ollama Path Traversal File Existence Disclosure
Synopsis: Ollama exposes an api/push path traversal that lets an attacker determine the existence of arbitrary files on the server, leaking filesystem layout.

Name: Ollama File Existence Disclosure via api/create
Synopsis: By supplying a crafted path to /api/create, an attacker can infer the existence of files on the host, aiding further attacks.

Name: OpenSSH regreSSHion Remote Code Execution
Synopsis: The OpenSSH server (sshd) on this host is affected by CVE-2024-6387 (regreSSHion), a signal handler race condition permitting unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux.

Name: NVIDIA Container Toolkit Container Escape (TOCTOU)
Synopsis: The NVIDIA Container Toolkit used to expose the A100 GPU to the Ollama container is affected by a TOCTOU container-escape flaw, allowing a malicious container image to gain host root. LLM/GPU workloads that pull external images are directly at risk.

Name: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service (nginx reverse proxy)
Synopsis: The nginx reverse proxy fronting the LLM API is vulnerable to HTTP/2 Rapid Reset, enabling a low-bandwidth DDoS that can exhaust the inference gateway.

Name: curl SOCKS5 Heap Buffer Overflow
Synopsis: The curl version bundled in the container image is affected by a heap buffer overflow in SOCKS5 proxy handling.

Name: SSL Certificate Signed Using Weak Hashing Algorithm
Synopsis: The X.509 certificate on the LLM gateway is signed with SHA-1, which is cryptographically weak.
